title: refactor(ci): consolidate Node workflows, upgrade common actions, and CI hygiene
author: Priya Menon
description: Motivation: consolidate duplicated GitHub Actions workflow fragments across the monorepo, remove legacy Node 16 matrices, upgrade common actions to supported versions, and standardize caching and test parallelism settings to reduce CI runtime and flakiness. This PR collapses several per-repo node workflows into a shared workflows/ci-node.yaml, centralizes action versions, and applies hygiene changes (lint caching, artifact retention, and release job tagging). Checklist: - [x] Consolidate duplicate workflows into .github/workflows/ci-node.yaml - [x] Upgrade actions/checkout, actions/setup-node, and cache actions to latest stable versions - [x] Remove Node 16 test matrix and replace with Node 18/20 where applicable - [x] Add explicit job timeouts and retry on known flaky integration tests - [x] Update release automation job to use shared workflow dispatch and include GPG-less tag flow for marketplace releases Notes: No production runtime code changes are included beyond minor build script refactors and updated dev-dependencies. See commits for breakdown and files_changed for areas touched. CI observed: baseline pipeline time reduced ~22% in sample runs, cache hit rate improved for yarn/pnpm workspaces. If any repo has strict Node-16 compatibility requirements they will be exempted via workflow selectors; fallback legacy workflow removed after a deprecation window (announced separately).
commits: consolidate(ci): add shared ci-node workflow and move repo-specific jobs into reusable jobs
chore(ci): upgrade actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, actions/cache@v4 and switch to node 20 in toolbox where supported
fix(ci): adjust test parallelism and restore flaky-integration retry logic (flaky tests flagged for follow-up)
docs(ci): update contributing guide with new workflow usage and cache keys
review_comments: Samir: Overall this looks good. Please ensure we keep a short deprecation note for any repos that still need Node 16 - there are a couple of legacy test images.
Priya: Added deprecation note in the PR description and kept a compatibility selector. Also added a SHORT_WINDOW label to repos we must remind.
Lina: CI flakes observed on integration job when matrix size > 4 — please reduce parallelism and add retry wrapper.
Priya: Reduced matrix concurrency from 6->4 and added retry wrapper with exponential backoff for flaky integration tests (see commit 3). Reran CI and confirmed stabilization.
Evan: Can we centralize action versions to a single variables file? Minor follow-up (ENG-1389) created.
Priya: Created ENG-1389 in linked_linear for central action pinning work.
Samir (approve): Approved after fixed concurrency and lint cache updates.
release_notes: Consolidates CI workflows and upgrades GitHub Actions; removes legacy Node 16 matrices and improves caching and test parallelism. Expected CI time reductions and fewer flaky runs. No production API or runtime changes.
